maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches to return; leave blank to use the org default (25) rather than passing a smaller number yourself.

searchTerm.title: Search Term
searchTerm.description: Text to match against CMS brand record names, e.g. "AMD". Omit to list every brand record in the org -- useful to check whether a specific brand actually has a brand record at all, distinct from just having logo/header images.
